name: Continuity by Ouroboros Apps
description: Continuity by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Story continuity for fiction writers: a series bible and novel memory that keeps characters, places, timelines, and plot facts consistent across chats. Tools: list_story_projects, create_story_project, get_continuity_context, search_story_canon, upsert_canon_entry, get_canon_history, list_approved_scenes, record_approved_scene, save_story_checkpoint, list_story_checkpoints, continuity_audit. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/continuity. Site: https://continuitywriter.com. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/continuity.
author: Ouroboros Apps
